payout_quote: Earn $100 per friend who opens a new account and completes the required steps. Then receive your bonus within 60 days.
steps: Hold a Capital One 360 Performance Savings account that is eligible for referrals (Copy referral code button on the official referrals page).
Copy your unique referral code and share it with friends and family.
Your friend opens a new qualifying 360 Performance Savings account using your referral code.
Your friend deposits $5,000 or more of external funds within 15 days of account opening.
Your friend maintains those funds for a 90-day holding period.
Your $100 bonus is added to your account within 60 days of your friend completing the 90-day holding period.
catches: High bar on the friend's side: they must deposit $5,000+ of external funds within 15 days and keep it there for 90 days - many friends will not qualify.
Long payout wait: your bonus arrives within 60 days AFTER your friend's 90-day holding period (up to ~5 months after the referral).
Cap: 'up to $500 for the year' - effectively 5 paid referrals per year.
Eligibility varies by account type, activity, or status - not every account holder can refer.
Referral reward is reported; bonus interest rules/1099 reporting may apply.
biggest_catch: Your friend must park $5,000+ of external money in the account for 90 days, and your bonus does not arrive until up to 60 days after that holding period ends - a high bar and a long wait.
eligibility: Capital One 360 Performance Savings account holders whose account shows the referral option (eligibility varies by account type, activity, status).
timing: Bonus added to your account within 60 days of your friend completing the required 90-day holding period.
